title: One complete physical set of An open basalt court around a sun-well of white-gold fire, iron floor veined with slag-gold, heat shimmer, storm sky above, no walls. The entire place is visible at once, as a single architectural model, ground included. No people, animals, or readable text. The set contains sun well: One low circular stone fire ring with a bowl of white-gold flame, a single object, no courtyard.; anvil altar: One blacksmith anvil of dark forged iron, a single object, no tools and no workshop.; throne dais: One low rectangular stone dais with worn steps, a single platform, no throne and no room.; gate column l: One twisted marble column standing alone, no base building and no second column.; gate column r: One twisted marble column standing alone, no base building and no second column.. The model is about 22 meters wide, 30 meters deep, and 18 meters tall.
author: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, TRELLIS.2
